definitions.explanation: sad; melancholy; feeling a vague, wistful sadness

examples.japanese: {物悲|ものがな}しい{気持|きも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{物悲|ものがな}しい。

⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{物悲|ものがな}しい⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at old photos sometimes makes me feel wistfully sad.

notes:
{物悲|ものがな}しい is an i-adjective describing a gentle, wistful sadness or melancholy.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing, vague prefix) + ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧ (sad)
- The prefix adds a sense of vagueness or indefiniteness to the sadness

USAGE:
- Describes a gentle, atmospheric sadness rather than acute grief
- Often associated with natural scenes, nostalgia, or fleeting moments
- Has a literary, poetic quality

COMMON ASSOCIATIONS:
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ (autumn): Season most associated with this feeling
- ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧ (twilight): Time of day often described as {物悲|ものがな}しい
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧ (memories): Nostalgic memories evoke this feeling

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物悲|ものがな}しい{気持|きも}ち (melancholy feeling)
- {物悲|ものがな}しい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (melancholy atmosphere)
- {物悲|ものがな}しい⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (sad expression)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧: Sad (direct, acute)
- ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧: Lonely, desolate
- {物悲|ものがな}しい: Wistful, atmospheric melancholy (literary)

REGISTER: Neutral to literary. Common in poetry and prose describing moods and scenes.
